ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity (white/light gray) to 55% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity contiguous regions occupy the distal segments of both lobes. A wide, low-intensity (black) vertical pillar occupies the central region and extends along the trailing edge margin. Transition zones between intensities show high-frequency mottling and pixelated stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel angle of 145 degrees and a shallow depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, fine-grained serrations along the trailing edge boundary; the frequency of peaks increases towards the lateral tips of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute, sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, scattered, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters are detected on the lower central low-intensity (black) region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark linear mark (approximately 20 pixels in length) is visible on the left lobe's high-intensity patch; several shorter, unaligned dark linear disruptions are visible on the right lobe's distal high-intensity field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark ovoid focal point is located on the lower boundary of the high-intensity patch on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'islanding' effect characterized by isolated low-intensity pixel clusters within the high-intensity fields of both lobes.
